description: Rothco Kids Camo Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt is the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality for your child's everyday adventures. Made from a soft and durable cotton / polyester fabric blend, this hoodie ensures your child stays comfortable all day long, whether they're at traveling or simply enjoying outdoor activities. The fleece-lined interior adds an extra layer of warmth, making it ideal for cooler weather. The classic camo design adds a touch of rugged style, while the front kangaroo pocket offers a convenient place to keep hands warm or store small essentials. Elastic wrist cuffs provide a snug fit, keeping the sleeves in place during play. This pullover sweatshirt is designed with both comfort and practicality in mind, making it a versatile addition to your child's wardrobe. Whether layering up for a chilly day or wearing it on its own, our Kids Camo Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt is a go-to choice for any activity.
